subject: Mobile Development
title: Will Phones Exist in 2040?
description: A quick, practical guide to Will Phones Exist in 2040?.

hook.text: In 2007, no one predicted the smartphone would replace cameras, wallets, maps, and music players.

buildup.text: AR glasses, brain interfaces, and ambient computing all aim to make the phone unnecessary.

discovery.text: But every previous 'phone killer' failed. Tablets, watches, and smart speakers all complement phones.

twist.text: The phone may not die — it may evolve into something unrecognizable, like it did from 2007 to now.

climax.text: The smartphone is the most successful consumer product in history. Replacing it won't be easy.

punchline.text: The phone won't disappear — it will transform.

quiz.question: What has happened to every predicted phone killer so far?
options: They all ended up complementing phones instead of replacing them
